reply_text:
@Gideon Sato: Your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in #inc-vtg-hartford: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant," with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. Your message also said the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel has nothing else about the guard until 11:03 AM, when Mateo Quiroga reported kiosk 1 back and the guard checking in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Mateo's 10:44 AM message notes six trucks waiting at the east gate. Your 11:08 AM message says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
